questions.question: After Jesus died, what did Joseph from Arimathea ask Pilate to give him?
Joseph from Arimathea laid Jesus in a tomb cut into the rock. Whose tomb was it?
After Jesus was buried, the chief priests and Pharisees reminded Pilate of something Jesus said while alive. What was it?

answers.text: After three days I will rise again
I will come down from the cross
Elijah will come to save Me

questions.question: Why did the chief priests and Pharisees ask Pilate to secure Jesus' tomb?

answers.text: They feared His disciples would steal Him away
They feared the crowds would riot at the tomb
They feared Joseph would move Him somewhere else
